title: GitHub Pages Publishing
goal: Publish a static site only after local rendering, links, and remote Pages behavior are verified
current_state: The docs site exists locally, but remote Pages state may lag or be blocked
constraints: Do not assume Pages is fixed until the public URL is read back
Do not edit GitHub Actions when account-level Actions are disabled
verifiers: Local mobile viewport has no obvious overlap
Public Pages URL returns the expected page or a documented external blocker

browser_verification: Check homepage and main tool page at 1280x800 and 390x844
forbidden_areas: Do not create releases or tags for a docs-only Pages fix
harness.local_secrets: Do not read tokens or credentials.
cost_strategy: Use stronger models for deployment diagnosis
Use cheaper models for link and copy checks
